description: Read-only. Look up property-type ids — the `propertyType` filter of `fastighetsbenchmark_search_property_units` and the domain of the EB0 parameter. Shared reference data, the same for every key; names are Swedish. Example: nameContains 'Kontor'. Read-only — never writes.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive property-type-name fragment (names are Swedish), e.g. 'Kontor'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: fastighetsbenchmark_list_property_types

id.description: Property-type id; use as propertyType in search_property_units, e.g. 2.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: List property types (shared)
